name: Seraphine
title: the Starry-Eyed Songstress

Q.name: High Note
Q.description: Seraphine projects a pure note, dealing 60/85/110/135/160 + 0.4×AP magic damage, increased against champions and monsters by the target's missing Health percentage up to (60/85/110/135/160 + 0.4×AP) × 1.75 damage below 25% Health.
Q.summary: Seraphine deals damage in an area.

W.name: Surround Sound
W.description: Seraphine spurs her nearby allied champions in song, granting them (0.2 + 0.0×AP) × 0.4 Move Speed, herself 0.2 + 0.0×AP decaying Move Speed and both (60/80/100/120/140 + 0.2×AP) × 1 Shield for 2.5 seconds. If Seraphine is already Shielded, she calls out to her allies to join her, restoring 8/10/12/14/16% missing Health to them after a 2.5 second delay.
W.summary: Seraphine Shields and Hastes nearby allies. If she is already Shielded she will Heal nearby allies as well.

E.name: Beat Drop
E.description: Seraphine unleashes a heavy soundwave, dealing 70/100/130/160/190 + 0.5×AP magic damage to enemies in a line and Slowing them by 99% for 1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4/1.5 seconds. Enemies that are already Slowed are Rooted instead, and Immobilized enemies are Stunned.
E.summary: Seraphine deals damage and impairs the movement of enemies in a line.

R.name: Encore
R.description: Seraphine takes the stage, projecting a captivating force that Charms for 1.25/1.5/1.75 seconds and deals 150/200/250 + 0.4×AP magic damage. Any champions struck (including allies) become part of the performance, extending the range of this Ability. Allied champions gain maximum Notes.
R.summary: Seraphine deals damage and charms enemies hit, refreshing the range with every allied or enemy champion hit.

Passive.name: Stage Presence
Passive.description: Every third basic spell will cast twice from Seraphine. Additionally, casting spells near allies grants her bonus magic damage and range on her next basic attack.
Passive.summary: Every third basic spell will cast twice from Seraphine. Additionally, casting spells near allies grants her bonus magic damage and range on her next basic attack.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Enchanter mage whose abilities echo every third cast. Wins fights with E root/stun and R charm across the team.
strengths: E slows, then roots if already slowed, then stuns if already immobilized
R charms everyone it passes through and extends through allies
Passive gives echo every third ability
profile.curveNote: Wants all three abilities to make echo combos; R at 6 is her spike.

Q.notes: Area burst, more against low targets.

E.notes: Slow; root if slowed; stun if already immobilized.

profile.windowAgainst: E or R on cooldown: engage then.
checks: Whether R is blockable by projectile blocks.
